lines.text: [thoughtfully] Okay. [pause] Honestly, I came in ready to be nice. [laughs softly] Now I'm kind of worried about my own idea.
[excited] No, this actually works. The costs make sense, and you could ship it this week. [laughs] I really wanted to find something wrong.

lines.text: [long pause] Fine. [pause] It does one thing, and it does it well. That's the best thing I can say about anything.

verdict.summary: Everyone liked it. Everyone is annoyed about that.
